initial_plan.metric: sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed per crash, by calendar year of crash_date
initial_plan.denominator: none; this is a count of pedestrian fatalities, not a rate
initial_plan.population: all police-reported motor vehicle crashes in NYC with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive
